mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 305.0 (as measured by CPIAUCSL), it signals persistent inflation that may trigger a more aggressive monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 305.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS increasing) and low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) indicates robust economic conditions that support corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% MoM and UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion phases, when housing starts (HOUST) are above 1,350,000 units, it signals strong consumer demand and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1,350.0 (thousands of units), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeds 104.0, it signals strong supply-side economic activity that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 104.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 305.0) and restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals a tightening cycle that pressures equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 305.0 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the interaction term in a regression has a positive coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to higher discount rates, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising above 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
